candidateDelta: Restore committed fixed-storage/Fresnel shader, including alpha discard. On its proven ordinary opaque plan, compute draw-constant sun direction, sun/ambient radiance, shadow parameters and base-color UV sin/cos in the vertex stage, deliver unchanged via four flat vec4 varyings. Broaden exactly group3 binding0 and, when base-color texture exists, group2 binding0 to vertex+fragment visibility. Keep fragment arithmetic, sample counts, geometry, numeric uploads and fallback paths.
hypothesis: Changing the frequency of constant calculations eliminates repeated per-fragment normalization/trigonometry/storage arithmetic. Flat interpolation preserves draw-constant values; exact native pixels required, no gain assumed.

timing.order: Declared controls then reverse,12 fresh serial runs, all samples, no overlapping CPU builds/checks

validationSequence: CPU structural/ABI tests and build; three-view native smoke with no speed inference; one predeclared controlled comparison; qualify any winner with full native lighting/material transitions and nonzero UV rotation/numeric light/shadow changes before integration acceptance. May reuse exact closed general-reference artifacts with explicit provenance.
failurePolicy: Preserve all outcomes. Do not repeat an unchanged failed timing window. Prior opaque experiment remains failed.
scope: Controlled causal diagnostic, not a new independent author round. Future author rounds still require a distinct feasible generated low-poly reference image.
hardware: SwiftShader software WebGPU only; no physical GPU inference.
